resources.string: Choose a model profile or HTTP JSON service for resources, skills and the configured editor/completion engine.
Create a model profile in the AI assistant settings first.
Request headers (one Name: Value per line)

POST JSON. Variables {{text}}, {{source}} and {{target}} are substituted inside string values. The default template uses LibreTranslate format; the response path defaults to /translatedText. The service must return text and retain protected markers. No redirects or automatic retries.

Translation sends the selected text to the chosen service and may incur model/API charges. Selecting this engine for automatic completion can send identifiers automatically. Saving settings does not send a test request.
HTTP is unencrypted: headers and text may be visible on the network. Use only a trusted endpoint.
Invalid translation settings. Check the endpoint, headers, JSON template and response path.
